description:
A hospital research board has approved sharing a heart disease clinical dataset, provided that direct identifiers are removed and age is generalized. 

Your goal is to:
1. Import the sensitive dataset from 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\EpiData\hospital_admissions_sensitive.csv' into Epi Info 7 Classic Analysis.
2. Create a new variable 'AgeDecade' that generalizes the 'age' variable into 10-year bins (e.g., 29->20, 34->30, 48->40).
3. Export a de-identified CSV file to 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\EpiData\public_heart_data.csv'.

The exported file MUST:
- Include the new 'AgeDecade' variable.
- Include all original clinical variables (sex, cp, trestbps, chol, etc.).
- EXCLUDE the 'MRN' (Medical Record Number) and 'PatientName' columns.
- EXCLUDE the original exact 'age' column.
